name: jadwal-sholat-mobile
description: Aplikasi mobile (Android & iOS) Jadwal Sholat — data Bimas Islam Kemenag RI

scripts.android: vite build && cap sync android && cap open android
scripts.ios: vite build && cap sync ios && cap open ios
scripts.run:android: vite build && cap sync android && cap run android
scripts.run:ios: vite build && cap sync ios && cap run ios
scripts.apk: vite build && cap sync android && cd android && .\gradlew.bat assembleRelease
scripts.assets: node scripts/make-assets.mjs && capacitor-assets generate --ios --android --iconBackgroundColor "#0b1026" --iconBackgroundColorDark "#0b1026" --splashBackgroundColor "#0b1026" --splashBackgroundColorDark "#0b1026" && node scripts/make-splash.mjs
